component.name: Pacnew Helper
component.summary: Review and apply updated system configuration files

description.p: When a package update brings a new version of a configuration file you changed, pacman keeps your file and saves the new one next to it as .pacnew. Pacnew Helper finds these files and helps you bring in the improvements without losing your own settings, explained in plain language.

ul.li: Three-way merge using the previous package version from the pacman cache: updates from the package are taken, your own changes are kept, only real conflicts need a decision
Side-by-side view of every difference with a recommended choice
Explanations and safety rules for important files (user accounts, sudoers, fstab, boot settings)
Automatic backups before every change and one-click undo
Handles leftover .pacsave files of removed packages
